verdicts.reason: A's left edges don't line up: the quote mark (~x80), headline and logo (~x57) and the review credit and rating (~x43) sit on three different edges. A's stack also floats high and leaves about 130px of dead space at the bottom. B puts the quote mark, headline, credit and rating on one left edge and spreads the content better down the tall canvas, though the logo is still indented. In both, the credit, rating and logo shrank to tiny, weak text, and the gaps between blocks are loose and uneven.
